name: EntityIdentitySkeleton
description: Loading placeholder with the same boxes as the loaded identity at each tier; with `tier="auto"` (default) it measures its container like EntityIdentity. Also available as `EntityIdentity.Skeleton`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Reserve the actions (header: one control; compact and row: the ⋯).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: facts
props.description: Reserve the facts line (header, compact) or the second line (row). Default true.

props.name: fill
props.description: Lets the component fill a box with a definite size.

props.name: tier
props.description: Named size tier or automatic container-based tier selection.
